Primer3 web tool methods chapter; no biological link to BBS2, RPGRIP1 or YAP1.

Review of PROM1 (CD133) biology; PROM1 is itself a retinal dystrophy gene (CORD12/MCDR2/STGD4) and the review is about the gene product, so it is on-topic for PROM1 even though the retinal angle is absent.
Hearing impairment in Usher syndrome; USH2 and USH2C (ADGRV1) and CLRN1 are central to the hearing phenotype. Empty abstract.
GPR161 mechanosensing at the primary cilium in neuronal migration; no ARSG or CEP290 link.
Review of canine inherited retinal degeneration models and gene therapy; the canine RPE65 (rd12) model is the canonical gene therapy target, and RPGRIP1 canine models are also in scope.
